{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check data types and missing values
df_info = trial_df.info()
df_describe = trial_df.describe(include='all')

# Check for duplicates
df_duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check unique values in key columns
unique_arms = trial_df['arm'].unique()
unique_sexes = trial_df['sex'].unique()
unique_sites = trial_df['site'].unique()

# Check response rates by sex
table_sex_response = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['responded'], margins=True)

df_info, df_describe, df_duplicates, unique_arms, unique_sexes, unique_sites, table_sex_response"}
